title: Beyond Gain: Measuring Skill Internalization for Agent Skill Retirement
abstract: arXiv:2610.32322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents retrieve skills from public hubs that hold up to about 100,000 entries and serve many models. As models improve, a hub must find the skills a given model has internalized, meaning it can do without them, and retire them for that model, yet internalization has not been measured with known reliability. Published rules that compare runs with and without a skill retire on the gain alone. The gain is near zero both for an internalized skill and when neither the model nor the skill delivers the capability, a state we call uncovered. We instead withhold the skill, score the model on a task synthesized from it, and trust a high unaided score only when another model gains from the skill, since nearly half of high scores come from tasks no model benefits from. Under four models, a published gain rule applied with one task per skill removes over half of the uncovered skills. On SkillsBench, 28 of its 31 retirements rest on probes no run

translated_title: 超越增益：面向智能体技能退役的技能内化度量
translated_abstract: LLM智能体从拥有多达约10万条目、服务于众多模型的公共技能库中检索技能。随着模型能力的提升，技能库必须识别出给定模型已经内化的技能（即模型无需这些技能也能完成任务），并为该模型将这些技能退役，然而内化程度此前从未得到可靠度量。已发表的规则通过比较有技能与无技能时的运行表现，仅依据增益来决定退役。但问题在于，无论是已内化的技能，还是当模型与技能都无法提供相应能力时（我们称之为“未覆盖”状态），增益都接近于零。我们转而采用如下方法：先向模型隐去该技能，让模型在根据该技能合成的任务上进行评分，且只有当另一个模型能从该技能中获益时，才信任模型的无辅助高分，因为近半数的高分来自没有任何模型能从中获益的任务。在四个模型上的实验表明，将已发表的增益规则应用于每技能一项任务时，会移除超过一半的未覆盖技能。在SkillsBench上，其31项退役决定中有28项基于无任何运行的探针……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出通过“隐去技能后评测+跨模型交叉验证高分”的方法可靠度量LLM智能体的技能内化程度，弥补仅凭增益判定会误删“未覆盖”技能的缺陷，从而实现准确的智能体技能退役。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes reliably measuring LLM agent skill internalization by withholding skills and cross-validating high unaided scores across models, fixing the flaw of gain-only retirement rules that mistakenly remove "uncovered" skills and enabling accurate agent skill retirement.
